title: It’s private health insurance
text: Ottonovasellsprivate health insuranceandexpat health insurance. It might not be the best option for you. Before you choose,understand your optionsandhow health insurance works.

title: It’s valid for a visa application
text: When you apply for a German visa orresidence permit, you need valid health insurance. Ottonova’s health insurance works for this. You can use it to apply for afreelance visa,work visaorBlue Card, for example. How to apply for a residence permit Health insurance for a residence permit

title: It’s expensive
text: Ottonova is more expensive than comparable private health insurances. You can get a better deal if youask an expert.2 Talk to a insurance brokerto find a cheaper option. Be careful; choosing the cheapest option can be a serious mistake, and cost you a lot of money later.

title: They speak English
text: Ottonovahas 24/7 English-speaking customer service. If you don’t speak German, this is very important. Public health insurers likeTechniker Krankenkasse,AOKandBarmerunofficiallyhave English-speaking customer service. Their website is in German, but you can easily get help in English. If you get health insurance from an English-speaking insurance broker, you can always get help from your broker. They can help you make insurance claims, and answer your insurance questions.

title: It’s a very small insurer
text: Ottonovais a very small health insurer, andit’s not profitable. They lost 2.3 million euros in 2024.8 They are in business since 2017.4In 2023, they only had 5,470 clients with private health insurance.7Other insurers have hundreds of thousands of customers.3Their solvency rating is also below average.5 Small health insurers are riskier. In 2010, a private health insurer with 25,000 members almost went bankrupt because of two sick patients.10City BKK’s bankruptcyshows what happens to you if your health insurer goes bankrupt. If you plan to live in Germany for a long time, choose a stable health insurer.6

This is what independent health insurance brokers think of Ottonova: “It’s a decent provider, but there is no real reason to chose them over others. They don’t have the best terms and conditions. They don’t have the best price/value. They are not the only one that is super digital. So as a broker, even though they pay really good commissions, it would not be my first or second choice/recommendation.”— Seamus Wolf, April 2025 “As a newer player, it lacks the long-term track record and product breadth of traditional insurers.
